name: proofable-mcp
description: Connect Proofable identity, permissions, and proofs to supported AI clients.

interface.shortDescription: Identity, permissions, and proofs for AI clients
interface.longDescription: Check what an AI agent may do before it acts, verify people and accounts, and reuse proof instead of repeating checks. The plugin connects your AI client to your Proofable profile, agents, permissions, and proofs.
defaultPrompt: Show my Proofable profile and current proofs.
Check what this agent is allowed to do before it acts.
